title: Route Autoloading
description: The "Smart Scanner" that removes manual imports.

sections.title: The Smart Scanner
sections.content: In a standard Express app, you must manually import every route file into index.js. Nodibranch uses Autoloading: a "Smart Scanner" that monitors the src/routes/ directory for any file ending in 'Routes.js' and dynamically mounts it to a corresponding /api/ endpoint.
